method: Read every source solution page as a native render, then independently reconstructed complete givens and demands, recomputed every part with standard-library arithmetic, exact fractions, combinatorial enumeration, normalCDF/inverseCDF, bracketed roots, finite-difference derivative checks and quadrature. sourceErrata.requiredPDFAction: Replace both incorrect3a² instances with6a²; retain final ratio and maximum.
